## Description

* Why?

ModelOpt global FP8 checkpoints store scalar per-tensor scales for split Qwen3.5 linear-attention projections. The mapper passed those scalars into projection packing, causing an IndexError before the model loaded.

* What?

Normalize global FP8 QKV/Z projections through the existing fused shared-scale path while preserving unquantized A/B projections and module exclusions. Add coverage for the ModelOpt checkpoint layout.
